verdict.rationale: Meltano's self-hosted mode lets you 'host and manage everything on your own servers' and 'own every part of your data infrastructure'. Its connectors move data to 'any destination' (e.g. S3, GCS, Azure Blob), so in practice the user decides where data lives. However, residency is only implied by self-hosting, not offered as an explicit feature, and the managed offering ('Meltano hosts... everything for you') shows no region choice. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection documentation, region options for the managed/hosted offering, and independent corroboration of residency control.
